cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Half an hour moving your sofa costs two hours painting my shed on Saturday. Let's see what you remember from my bargaining lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I paint after lunch? Saturday's my only lie-in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still counting only your inconvenience. Afternoon costs me cricket. Three hours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hire a painter. But the sofa has to go up three flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to buy your way out. Two painter-hours for loading, one for stairs. Send him Saturday morning; your teacher keeps his cricket.
